# RX Tracker NEXT 4.0.0-next.96

Patient importing keeps its familiar review and adds Import History, Files to Correct and Corrected Files tabs. Error files retain the original columns with correction metadata; corrected subsets can be reimported. Original and corrected uploads are retained with dated filenames and integrity-checked downloads.

Phone-only matches with different DOBs and dissimilar names are excluded from another patient review. Exact name/DOB and Patient ID conflicts remain blocked; similar-name and uncertain-DOB checks remain.

Enabled by default in production; IMPORT_REVIEW_V2=false and restart restores baseline behavior without deleting retained files. No new migration, dependency change or automatic existing-patient rewrite. Existing history is not backfilled. CSV only.

Verify SHA256SUMS.txt and install through Project Control option 8 then 15. Preserve the paired application/database rollback set. Installation remains an operator action.

Built and validated locally; LOCAL_VALIDATION.json records exact source and checks. Existing dependency/security findings remain documented in docs/LOCAL_RELEASE_SECURITY_REVIEW.md.
